author: China Insights
description: In CCP propaganda, Zhou Enlai and his wife Deng Yingchao are portrayed as revolutionary partners bound by an unbreakable, lifelong bond; in reality, however, Deng Yingchao was merely a political partner—a tool—chosen by Zhou, and his romantic life was far from the sanctified image promoted by the Party. Today, let us peel back the layers of history and discuss three individuals who played significant roles in Zhou Enlai’s emotional life.
title: Why China's Leaders Buried Zhou Enlai's True Story

author: China Insights
description:
A light aircraft crashed into Beijing's tallest skyscraper, sending shockwaves across China and triggering intense public speculation.

According to publicly available reports and online discussions, the aircraft deviated from its planned route before striking the building. The incident immediately raised difficult questions about aviation safety, emergency response, and one of the world's most tightly controlled airspaces.

In this episode, we reconstruct the timeline of the flight, examine what is currently known, explore the competing theories circulating online, and compare the incident with historical cases that exposed weaknesses in national air defence systems.

As with many developing stories, some claims remain unverified. Our goal is to separate confirmed facts from speculation and examine why this event has attracted such extraordinary public attention.

#Beijing #China #Aviation #AirSafety #Investigation #CurrentAffairs #ChinaInsights #Analysis
title: The Plane Crash That Shocked Beijing: Questions No One Is Answering I China Insights
